Step T020  /  visual re-check  /  iPhone 17 simulator

Developer settings, re-measured

VERDICT PASS 3 of 3 checks pass  ·  0 flags  ·  3 prior defects closed

The first run failed this step on one row: at the largest text size the Force offline label held its full single-line width and pushed the native switch about 7 pt off a 402 pt screen, and the pill sat 30 pt above the row's centre. After the fix the label wraps, the switch clears the screen edge by 16.0 pt with its rounded cap intact, and it is centred to within 0.35 pt.

Device iPhone 17 · 402 × 874 pt Runtime Expo Go · host.exp.Exponent Capture 3 px per pt · last column 401.67

  e102  'Force offline'                              value='0'

Selecting prc-0873 really did move the draft — it flipped to checked and prc-0421 to unchecked. Cancel then dismissed the modal: the snapshot has zero RNSModalScreen nodes, one "Your practice" navigation bar and home's own content, so it landed on home rather than on a stacked copy of it. Reopening the screen shows prc-0421 still checked, with latency and the offline flag untouched. The button is 48 pt tall at both text sizes and grows from 68.33 to 85.67 pt wide without colliding with the title.

Notes

Scope
  • Only the three dispatched checks were re-run. Scenarios 1–5 from the first run were not repeated, though the reopened screen in check 3 incidentally re-confirms the structure and 48 pt targets at medium, and the AX3XL page in check 1 re-confirms that nothing else on it overlaps.
  • The uncapped heading scale at AX3XL is still there — a 543 pt title and a 600 pt blurb. Accepted in T018, not re-opened.
Cleanup — left the screen via Cancel, so nothing from this run was applied; the device ends on home at medium text size, read back from simctl ui … content_size. No other simulator touched, no repository file edited, nothing committed.
